Four published farming runs

Your pocket field guide

Map: open the layer picker, tap a pin, and read the action and danger tips. Nearby small resources group into a count; tap the group to zoom in.

Updated for October 30, 2026.

Routes: tap the route name to choose one of four published box runs. Each uses its recorded team side and exact overhead path. Tap a line or use the arrows to follow its numbered sections. Expand the step card for start conditions, source links and the full sequence. The creator’s practice time is not a guaranteed match duration. Next never records a clear.

On your phone: pinch to zoom and drag the map. The bottom tabs switch sections. Tap the card header to expand its details, or the × icon to return to the map. The Details button on the map restores the card.

Keep it handy: in Safari, use Share → Add to Home Screen. In Chrome, use its menu → Add to Home screen. Saved places and checklist progress stay on this device.

The visible match clock drives route start checks and resource countdowns. Tap its time to sync it, then Start. Mark an entire camp cleared to track its expected return. This guide does not read a live match. Pins use a top-down projection; check the floor or entrance notes.
